component.name: Rclone Explorer
component.summary: Browse, transfer and sync files on all your cloud storage with rclone

description.p: Rclone Explorer (formerly Rclone Browser) is a modern GUI for rclone on Windows and Linux. Browse, upload, download and sync files on Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, pCloud, S3 and 70+ other services.

ul.li: Tabs, and icon or details views with sortable columns
Transfers you can pause and resume, with live progress
Saved tasks you can run again with one click

description.p: The rclone program is bundled, and the app keeps it up to date.

screenshot.caption: Your remotes on the Home page
Transfers with live progress, in the dark theme
